Each is transcribed from the source with the verbatim passage it rests on, checked against the PDF text on 2026-09-27 (Sophon arXiv:2405.12972v1; ATL-PHYS-PUB-2026-013 as mirrored on INSPIRE, recid 3177039); seven added 2026-10-01 from the PDF texts of Sophon App. B, the Li thesis, ParT, Mehta and Bonner v2 and Hong et al.; the last eleven added 2026-10-01 (later) from the PDF texts of Sophon App. B.1, ATLAS GN2 (arXiv:2505.19689v2), CMS PaRT (arXiv:2604.09809v1), Huh et al. (arXiv:1608.08614v2), RS3L (arXiv:2403.07066v2) and the CMS public page of CMS-DP-2026-104. An optional 'tex' field is how the value prints when the source's typography (a superscript) cannot appear in a macro body; the 'value' must still occur in the quote. make_tables.py emits each as a \Lit... macro so the manuscript quotes none of them by hand. Two added 2026-10-01 (later still): Sophon's parameter count from the PDF text of App. B.1 (it matches the 2,304,688 trainable parameters of the released checkpoint), and GloParT v1's class count from the 'Model generations' table of the CMS public page of CMS-DP-2026-104, read live on 2026-10-01. Eight Sophon facts for the X->bb/X->bs protocol added 2026-10-10 from the same PDF text. Thirteen added 2026-10-29 from the PDF texts of Huh et al., Hong et al., the objectives comparison (arXiv:2606.14870), MPM, ParT, Mahajan et al., Bukchin et al. and Kornblith et al., for the related work. Five added 2026-10-29 from the PDF texts of Mahajan et al. (Fig. 1), Sophon App. B.5 and the energy flow network paper's data set.
